prisoners.name: Hannah Chavez
prisoners.description: Hannah Chavez was arrested by federal agents during the September 19, 2025 demonstration against immigration enforcement outside the Broadview immigration detention facility in Illinois. A CBP officer alleged that she tripped him as he pursued another demonstrator; this account is an allegation, not a finding of guilt. A Homeland Security Investigations report records her detention in a common holding area, questioning after Miranda warnings, and refusal to speak with agents. She was fingerprinted, issued a misdemeanor assault citation and released after processing. A later CBP arrest chart lists the disposition as a violation notice. The reviewed records do not establish a conviction or sentence.

cases.charges: Misdemeanor assault allegation under 18 U.S.C. 111; violation notice
cases.sentence: Released after fingerprinting and issuance of a misdemeanor citation; no conviction or sentence established in the reviewed records. The September 19 arrest report identifies Hannah B. Chavez and records actual detention and subsequent release. The exact release date and custody duration are not stated and remain unset. The report contains an apparent statutory typo, 8 USC 111; its synopsis and the CBP chart identify 18 USC 111. The chart covers September 2 through October 29, 2025 and was filed November 24; its historical custody flag is not evidence of a present-day case disposition. Sources: https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.ilnd.487571/gov.uscourts.ilnd.487571.284.3.pdf (pages 1-3); https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.ilnd.487571/gov.uscourts.ilnd.487571.284.40.pdf (page 1).
